CINEDESI

Copyright

CineDesi is designed around rights-safe discovery. We do not intend to host unauthorized full copyrighted films or provide tools for bypassing DRM or access controls.

Posters and images

Artwork is published only when its source and reuse status have been reviewed. Public availability alone does not mean an image is licensed for reuse.

Trailers

We prefer official rights-holder, studio or distributor destinations and do not treat arbitrary re-uploads as verified official trailers.

Where to watch

Watch links should lead only to verified official or authorized viewing destinations. CineDesi does not use fake play or download buttons.

Rights concerns

If a rights-holder identifies material that should not appear on CineDesi, it can be reviewed for removal, correction or licensing. CineDesi now provides a formal rights-holder request workflow for those concerns.
